---
title: "About the data"
---

## Source and coverage

This site uses the U.S. Census Bureau's 2019–2023 American Community Survey (ACS) five-year estimates for Sarasota County, Florida. The five-year ACS combines survey responses collected over five years to provide estimates for local areas.

The population, median age, median household income, and median home value measures are direct ACS estimates. The poverty and rental shares are calculated by dividing the ACS estimate for the relevant group by its reported total. They are approximate shares; margins of error for those calculated values are not computed here.

## Load the estimates

The Census Bureau requires a free API key for data requests. [Request a key](https://api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html), activate it using the email from the Census Bureau, then add it to your local R environment:

```r
tidycensus::census_api_key("YOUR_KEY", install = TRUE)
```

Restart R and render the site again. The key is stored in your local `.Renviron`; do not share or commit it.

## Measures

| Measure | ACS table | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Population | B01003 | Total population |
| Median age | B01002 | Median age in years |
| Median household income | B19013 | Median household income in the past 12 months |
| Median home value | B25077 | Median value of owner-occupied housing units |
| Below poverty line | B17001 | People below poverty level divided by the poverty universe |
| Renter-occupied housing | B25003 | Renter-occupied units divided by occupied housing units |
